baseTendency.strong_yes: Definite Yes - strong, clear and unambiguous affirmation (example: Sun, Earth)
baseTendency.yes: Yes - supportive, positive trend going with the flow
baseTendency.uncertain: Uncertain - dependent on circumstances, time or intrinsic clarity
baseTendency.no: No - current conditions do not support progress
baseTendency.strong_no: Definite No - hard stop, demolition or closure energy (example: Tower)

orientationImpact.low: The archetype is strong; even if the card is reversed, the core message is largely preserved
orientationImpact.standard: Reversal effect is normal; clarity is reduced, conditions come into play
orientationImpact.high: Ambiguity is intense; in the inverted position, meaning is severely blurred

reversalStyle.delay: Delay - in the right direction but the timing is not yet ripe
reversalStyle.internal: Inner block - fear, indecision or self-sabotage
reversalStyle.shadow: Shadow field - repressed emotion, denied reality or unconscious influence
reversalStyle.imbalance: Imbalance - excessive control, excessive emotion or loss of direction
reversalStyle.blocked: Blockage - energy is not flowing, there is an external or internal barrier
